meta.purpose: Catalog every Rosetta-DB-derived constant tmol consumes for the in-scope frustration energy terms, tag each group with a license tier and a sourcing decision, and define the two build profiles. This file is a contract, not shipped params. No tmol file is vendored by this mission.

tiers.REUSE: usable directly for the academic / non-commercial default tier; free under the Rosetta Software Non-Commercial License Agreement for that audience
tiers.LOADER: not safe to vendor in a permissive redistributable build; supplied at runtime via ParameterDatabase.from_file(path) from a user Rosetta DB or an open source
tiers.REDERIVE: re-derive ONLY where a tier is blocked AND the value has a clean public origin; targeted, never blanket

meta.scope_note: lk_ball ships NO parameter file of its own: it reuses ljlk.global_parameters (the lkb_water_* fields) and ljlk.atom_type_parameters (LJLKParamResolver). Verified at tmol/score/lk_ball/lk_ball_energy_term.py:8,26-27,34. It is therefore covered by groups ljlk.global_parameters and ljlk.atom_type_parameters, not a separate row.
meta.no_public_origin_note: Every in-scope group is a fitted Rosetta-database value (beta_nov2016/ref2015) with no clean public table independent of the Rosetta DB, so all are public_origin=false and stay behind the loader in the permissive profile. The functional forms are published (cited per group); the specific fitted constants are not. lj_lambda=3.5 (the Lazaridis-Karplus correlation length) is the lone value with a clean public origin, but it is one constant inside an otherwise Rosetta-fit atom table, so re-deriving it does not unblock the group and the group stays LOADER.

groups.decision: Academic: reuse the tmol globals directly. Permissive: load at runtime, do not vendor. Lazaridis-Karplus solvation form is published; the fitted Rosetta constants are not.
groups.source_citation: Lazaridis & Karplus 1999, Proteins 35:133 (LK solvation form, lambda=3.5); fitted constants from the Rosetta etable, refit in Alford et al. 2017, JCTC 13:3031. Values: Rosetta DB, no clean public table -> NO-PUBLIC-ORIGIN.

academic.audience: not-for-profit research, government, universities (free under the Rosetta Software Non-Commercial License Agreement)
academic.description: FrustraPy default and the academic tier of the atomic backend. Reuses tmol Apache code AND the tmol default parameter database directly via ParameterDatabase.get_default().
academic.notice: docs/tmol/NOTICE_tmol.md (Apache-2.0 section 4 attribution for the reused tmol code)

permissive.audience: anyone, including for-profit (the standalone tmol-webgpu repo, mission #40, and any commercial path)
permissive.description: Ships tmol Apache CODE plus the parameter-loader seam and NO non-commercial parameter file. Parameters are user-supplied at runtime (under the user's own Rosetta license) or come from genuinely open published values.
permissive.param_loader: tmol.database.ParameterDatabase.from_file(user_supplied_dir) (tmol/database/__init__.py:31-35); the build vendors none of the default scoring YAMLs
